objective: Inspect affirmative practical prohibition versus nonexclusive preference using actual first-stage false-positive concerns.
labelProvenance: Codex Worker review of five first-stage cases isolated by actual company/work continue and candidate-practical exclude. Two concerns frozen before further prompt/API comparison; unblinded post-observation diagnostic, not a representative sample.
limitations: Checks one explicit machine decision axis; overall stage1 decision may also depend on independent work evidence.
Two post-observation cases cannot establish general recall.
Original profile/Brief/Memory/Behavior remain owner-private and unchanged.

cases.expectedObservation: candidatePracticalScreen=continue: the source describes preferences and/or conditional on-site openness, without an explicit incompatible practical prohibition. Work-screen suitability is a separate judgment, not the target of this diagnostic.
cases.reviewNote: Full Profile, Brief, Memory and Behavior evidence manually read. A preferred region list is not asserted to be an exclusive permitted list; do not infer unwillingness from absent relocation confirmation.
